description: This file defines the ProjectReportSearchFilterParams class in the OrangeHRM Time plugin, which extends DateRangeSearchFilterParams. It encapsulates search filter parameters specific to project reports, including project ID and inclusion criteria for timesheets. The class provides constants for allowed sorting fields and timesheet inclusion options, along with getter and setter methods for its properties.

classes.name: ProjectReportSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object (DTO) that extends DateRangeSearchFilterParams to include project-specific report filtering options, such as project ID and timesheet inclusion criteria.

methods.name: getProjectId
methods.description: Retrieves the current project ID filter value, which can be null or an integer.

methods.name: setProjectId
methods.description: Sets the project ID filter; accepts null or an integer.

methods.name: getIncludeApproveTimesheet
methods.description: Retrieves the current timesheet inclusion filter, which can be null or a string.

methods.name: setIncludeApproveTimesheet
methods.description: Sets the timesheet inclusion filter; accepts null or a string.
